glossEn: the relative magnitude of something with reference to a criterion
note: the relative magnitude of something with reference to a criterion or standard。线索：a large / the total amount of。不加 of 时直接接名词。
be tantamount or equivalent to。线索：amount to + 数量 / amount to + 名词。amount to 既是「总计」也是「等于」，两种中文译法指向同一条释义。
